backend: Offline Chrome, Moxi orthographic samples, SVG
fixture: Six rigid panels; 20 mm pitch, 40 mm depth, 30 degree tilt

scenarios.name: flat-pitch pointer / numeric parity
scenarios.steps: Drag the visible circle to 24.5 mm / 30 degrees; apply; undo; enter the same numbers; undo.
scenarios.expected: Preview updates both views and controls; applied geometry equals numeric geometry; each edit undoes once.
scenarios.observed: Preview updates both views and controls; applied geometry equals numeric geometry; each edit undoes once.

scenarios.observed: Preview updates both views and controls; applied geometry equals numeric geometry; each edit undoes once.

scenarios.name: folded-tilt pointer / numeric parity
scenarios.steps: Drag the visible circle to 20 mm / 60 degrees; apply; undo; enter the same numbers; undo.
scenarios.expected: Preview updates both views and controls; applied geometry equals numeric geometry; each edit undoes once.
scenarios.observed: Preview updates both views and controls; applied geometry equals numeric geometry; each edit undoes once.

scenarios.name: flat / folded pitch at a steep fold
scenarios.steps: Set 10 mm / 75 degrees. Drag flat pitch to 24.5 mm, apply and undo; repeat from the folded pitch circle.
scenarios.expected: The same pitch edit produces exactly the same linked patch in both representations, even at the tightest fold and while narrow readouts wrap.
scenarios.observed: The same pitch edit produces exactly the same linked patch in both representations, even at the tightest fold and while narrow readouts wrap.

scenarios.name: keyboard access, steps and limits
scenarios.steps: Tab from the page through all three circles. Use arrows, Home/End and Enter; undo or Escape.
scenarios.expected: All circles are reachable; pitch steps 0.1 mm and tilt steps 1 degree; endpoints match numeric entry; focus survives redraw.
scenarios.observed: All circles are reachable; pitch steps 0.1 mm and tilt steps 1 degree; endpoints match numeric entry; focus survives redraw.

scenarios.name: in-flight cancel and pointer bounds
scenarios.steps: Drag each circle, press Escape before releasing, move again and release; repeat with Cancel edit. Drag far beyond both limits.
scenarios.expected: Cancellation restores all linked values without history and later pointer movement cannot revive the draft; pointer bounds match Home/End.
scenarios.observed: Cancellation restores all linked values without history and later pointer movement cannot revive the draft; pointer bounds match Home/End.

scenarios.name: invalid drafts and direct-entry rejection
scenarios.steps: Submit blank, out-of-range and fractional values. Try a geometry drag and handle arrow with an invalid other parameter, then Escape.
scenarios.expected: Rejections preserve the last valid geometry, draft inputs and undo history; Escape restores the committed inputs.
scenarios.observed: Rejections preserve the last valid geometry, draft inputs and undo history; Escape restores the committed inputs.

scenarios.name: per-view centroid picking at bounds
scenarios.steps: For 10/30 mm and 0/75 degrees, click the actual centroid of every panel in each view; traverse the panel control with arrows.
scenarios.expected: All 48 face clicks select the intended shared panel; handles and selected outlines do not steal a neighbor.
scenarios.observed: All 48 face clicks select the intended shared panel; handles and selected outlines do not steal a neighbor.

scenarios.name: measurement drafts and interleaved undo
scenarios.steps: Attach/undo the measurement during numeric and both direct previews; cancel. Interleave a measurement with two view edits and undo in order.
scenarios.expected: Measurement attachment preserves drafts; geometry edits share one history and leave selection and measurement state intact.
scenarios.observed: Measurement attachment preserves drafts; geometry edits share one history and leave selection and measurement state intact.
